literal_meaning: শরীর বিছানো বা পাতা করা (body to spread or lay down)
figurative_meaning_en: To exhaust or wear out the body through hard labor
similar_in_english: Work one's fingers to the bone
example_sentences_in_bangla: শরীর পাত করে দুমুঠো অন্ন জোগাড় করছি।
গরিব লোকেরা শরীর পাত করে জীবিকা নির্বাহ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: I'm wearing out my body just to gather a handful of rice.
Poor people sustain their livelihood by exhausting their bodies.
note: This idiom reflects the struggles of manual laborers in Bengali society.
